title: Emergency Danger Signs Intercept
source: MoHFW / WHO Maternal & Gynaecological Emergency Guidelines

items.text: Soaking through more than 2 large pads or tampons every hour for 2 or more consecutive hours
Severe dizziness, fainting, clammy cold skin, or breathlessness while bleeding
Sudden, excruciating or sharp lower abdominal / pelvic pain unable to stand upright
High fever (> 101°F / 38.5°C) combined with severe pelvic pain or foul-smelling discharge
Active thoughts of harming yourself or your baby

clinical_review_status: Checked against national emergency referral guidelines.
